name: BasedBot
summary: Token trading page on the BasedBot on-chain trading terminal; the page renders with JavaScript, so little was readable.
description: A single token's page on basedbot.app, described as "BasedBot Terminal, the fastest way to trade on-chain". The page renders with JavaScript, so only the title, meta description, navigation (Discover, Pulse, Trackers, Portfolio, Rewards) and the chain switcher (ETH, SOL, BNB) could be read; no token details were available.
